mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_0 (product_id, creator_id, product_type, title, short_title, price, detail, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{creatorId}, #{productType}, #{title}, #{shortTitle}, #{price}, #{detail}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, creator_id, product_type, title, short_title, price, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_0 WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_0 WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT product_id, creator_id, product_type, title, short_title, price, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_0 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT product_id, creator_id, product_type, title, short_title, price, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_1 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ) p ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_0 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_1 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) )
